about_the_game:
Do stuff just by moving!

BLOKES on BLOCKS! is a simple and easy to play party battle royale game.

All you have to do is move! Based off your block and your opponent's moves, actions happen automatically!

Play with up to 6 players and knock each other off the stage. Last bloke standing wins!

Experience exciting and silly matches with unique stage hazards and crazy items!

Your offense and defense depends on timing your movement! So read your blokes' moves closely!

KEY FEATURES

  • Maximum of 6 players for online and offline play!!!

  • Simple controls suitable for everyone!!!

  • Stage hazards to add extra spice to your battles!!!

  • Pick your favorite "dad bod" for your bloke!

  • Win to unlock new costumes and skins!

  • Customize your home screen!

short_description: BLOKES on BLOCKS is a casual party game where you push your friends around. With simple controls this game is easy to pick up and play, suitable for everyone. Your actions happen just by moving around. Timing is everything so predict your blokes' next moves and knock them off their blocks!
